dialogue.ja: パニラムに参加できますか？ちょっと自信がありません。みなさん、今日は動詞の過去否定形を学びます。

dialogue.text: So today we're going to learn the new past negative form as well as review the negative form and also the more you verbs. And again we're going to focus on the casual form.

dialogue.local: So today we're going to learn the new past negative form as well as review the negative form and also the more you verbs. And again we're going to focus on the casual form.
dialogue.en: So today we're going to learn the new past negative form as well as review the negative form and also the more you verbs. And again we're going to focus on the casual form.

dialogue.text: So the past negative form that's used when speaking informally, okay.
dialogue.zh: 過去否定形是用在非正式口語中，了解嗎？
dialogue.ja: 過去否定形は、カジュアルな会話で使います、わかりましたか？
dialogue.local: So the past negative form that's used when speaking informally, okay.
dialogue.en: So the past negative form that's used when speaking informally, okay.

dialogue.text: So we treated the last 90 part like the music player and changed the last E into kah bah. So the past negative is always nai kah bah for the informal speech.
dialogue.zh: 我們把最後的部分像音樂播放器一樣改變，把最後的e變成かった。過去否定形口語總是くなかった。
dialogue.ja: 最後の部分を音楽プレーヤーのように扱い、「e」を「かった」に変えました。過去否定形は口語で「くなかった」です。
dialogue.local: So we treated the last 90 part like the music player and changed the last E into kah bah. So the past negative is always nai kah bah for the informal speech.
dialogue.en: So we treated the last 90 part like the music player and changed the last E into kah bah. So the past negative is always nai kah bah for the informal speech.

dialogue.zh: 所以atsuiくなかった是『不熱』的過去否定，我沒去是いかなかった。
dialogue.ja: 「暑くなかった」は過去の否定、「行かなかった」は「行く」の過去否定です。

dialogue.en: So at 2 kah nai kah bah, it wasn't hot. I didn't go, you say, E kah nai kah bah.

dialogue.ja: 動詞の過去否定形は「くなかった」で終わります。覚えていますか？

dialogue.ja: 例えば「行く」と言ったら、「いく」、「いかない」、「いかなかった」と言います。わかりましたか？
